message.content: Hey, I need to send a quick text to Pierre. I can't make it to our pottery class this Saturday. Tell him I have a migraine and ask if I can pick up the materials next week.

content.text: Sure. Should I keep it brief, or do you want to sound more apologetic?

message.content: Just simple. I’m exhausted from the pharmacy. Karim says I need to rest.

content.text: Okay, I’ll draft that. Is there anything else you need help with for the weekend?

message.content: Yes. Check my calendar for this Saturday morning. I think I have the food bank shift.

content.text: It’s there. 9 AM to 1 PM at the community center. Do you want me to send a reminder to your phone at 8 AM?

message.content: Yes, please. And while you’re at it, look up the recipe for lentil soup. I need to buy ingredients. I want to make a big batch for the freezer.

content.text: I found three options. One is a traditional Moroccan style, another is a quick weeknight version. Which one do you prefer?

message.content: The traditional one. But check the shopping list. I already have cumin and turmeric.

content.text: Got it. I’ve removed those from the list. You need lentils, carrots, onions, tomatoes, and olive oil. Do you want me to add them to your weekly shopping list for Tuesday?

message.content: Yes, add them to Tuesday’s list. And remind me to check the expiry date on the olive oil bottle in the pantry before I go.

content.text: I’ve added the reminder to check the olive oil to your Tuesday morning alerts. Anything else?

message.content: No, that’s it. Send the message to Pierre now.
